features.behavior: Visual Timeline + Agent Memory — single source of truth for 'what changed, where, when'. Aggregates events from six sources (git commits, hook logs, agent activity, task changes, goal changes, file changes) into a 10k-event in-memory ring + 50MB NDJSON file at ~/.config/bizar/timeline.jsonl with rotation. Exposes a Timeline view in the dashboard (date-grouped list with filter bar + AI summary button) and a timeline_query MCP tool (mcp__bizar__timeline_query — name has no bizar_ prefix; MCP namespace provides it) for agents. SessionStart hook primes the model with recent activity via BIZAR_TIMELINE_PRIME=1. appendEvent MUST NEVER throw — returns null on bad input. Dedupe by {source, sourceId} so hook re-emits are no-ops.
